**Build passes now.** Exit code `0`, `dist/bundle.js` emitted.

One real bug, in `src/core/settings.js`: the line `maxRetries: retries` used a name that was never defined. It now reads `env.retries`, with a fallback of `2` when the caller passes nothing.

The 3 warnings are still there, and they are noise. `build.js` prints them as fixed text at set points in the loop. The files they blame do not exist. Clearing them means editing `build.js`, not fixing any code.
